items.text: Andy Reid says Kenneth Walker (groin) is getting better but they don't want to do something stupid; Levitan agrees playing him at less than 100% would be stupid especially with huge BUF game in Week 12. Chiefs are big home favorites vs ARI.
items.why: Reid caution + Levitan agreement on not rushing; Emmett Johnson strong prior usage
items.implication: Likely sit or limited; handcuff priority
items.opportunity: Backup RB full workload if out

items.text: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield did not practice today due to a foot injury.
items.implication: Trending toward sit; Daniels possible start
items.opportunity: Bucs skill players down if out

items.text: FULL CHUB(A) FOR MR. HUBBARD! Chuba Hubbard is my RB6 in rest-of-season rankings.
In first game with Kirk Cousins, Vikings set a season-high in Pass Rate Over Expectation. Clear Kevin O'Connell wants to throw a lot; confirms pass-heavy for Jefferson routes.
items.implication: Boost Jefferson/MIN pass catchers ROS and playoffs (favorable QB DvP)

items.text: NE loses Drake Maye, potentially for the season; hard to find any positives even if Tommy DeVito plays. Team-by-team notes highlight NE negatives.
items.why: Ankle injury likely fracture; Rapoport surprising if plays again 2026
items.implication: NE offense downgrade ROS; DeVito or import QB

items.text: I am CLOSING IT OUT on Jaylen Waddle. The target share is nice. The production is not.
Lions placed EDGE Aidan Hutchinson on injured reserve and activated S Kerby Joseph from Reserve/PUP.
No IR for Jordan Addison, per coach Kevin O’Connell.
Colts ruled out TE Will Mallory (hamstring), OT Bernhard Raimann (concussion), DT Jerry Tillery (calf), OT Jalen Travis (knee) and CB Charvarius Ward Sr. (knee) for TNF vs Texans.
Joe Milton starts at QB for Eagles; Sean Mannion remains offensive play caller.
We have JT ahead of Chase Brown in the ROS150 half-PPR. In full-PPR, Brown would be further ahead.
Predictive DvP data underutilized; sort by fantasy playoffs Weeks 15-17. Vikings offense faces most favorable QB schedule: DET, WAS, NYJ.
Kaelon Black available in 61% Yahoo; 60+ scrimmage yards three straight, scored twice past three; viable flex even with CMC healthy. All RBs targeting on waivers.
items.why: Usage and production as CMC handcuff
